author: GameTrailers
description: Cash Heist City is JOGO’s biggest Fortnite drop yet, a full-scale, mission-driven sandbox where players can rob, race, and raise hell inside a living, breathing city. Built in UEFN, the map throws you into a wide-open playground where you can run heists, chase bounties, or ditch the script entirely and stack cash your own way, stealing cars, jacking loot, and building your empire across sessions. Every building is open, every street is in play, and every player is either an opportunity or a problem. Plans fall apart fast, getaways turn into ambushes, and the fastest way up is often taking some else down.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Heng Blade weapon in action in this new Where Winds Meet trailer for the Wuxia open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China at the tenth century. Regarded as a pinnacle of Tang Dynasty cold weapon craftsmanship, the long-awaited Heng Blade features a straight-angled tip and sharp, precise lines. The Heng Blade introduces a “deflect-and-counter” mechanism for agile, proactive suppression, forming the new “Stonesplit Strength” martial arts path alongside the heavy-hitting Mo Blade.

In Where Winds Meet, you assume the role of a young sword master as you embark on a journey to uncover the mysteries of your own identity. Let the wind carry your legend on an epic journey to the East! 

Where Winds Meet's Hexi Expansion Chapter 2: Liangzhou will be available on April 2, 2026.

#WhereWindsMeet #Gaming #IGN
title: Where Winds Meet - Official Heng Blade Gameplay Trailer
